title: BaalvionServiceDescriptor
description: Governance descriptor for a service / bounded context. One per service, validated in CI. Drives the ArgoCD ApplicationSet, CODEOWNERS review routing, dependency graph and SLO dashboards.

domain.description: Locked 6-domain architecture axis (orthogonal to division). REQUIRED — enforced by catalog/enforce.mjs.

ingress.description: Platform API ingress. Exactly one descriptor (the gateway) may be 'public' — enforced by catalog/enforce.mjs C4. Default (omitted) = internal.

apis.description: proto packages or REST base paths exposed

runtime.description: Where this service actually answers. The address book the status prober reads; before this existed the same fact was spread across 14 disagreeing files (pm2 configs, Caddyfile, docker-compose, gateway proxy.js, client.ts, health-check.ps1, prose docs). Derived from deploy/consolidated/ via catalog/scripts/derive-runtime.mjs — that directory is production truth, the others are not.

deployment.description: consolidated-box = supervised by pm2 inside one of the app-* containers. standalone = its own container/host. not-deployed = declared here but nothing runs it; the console reports 'not deployed' rather than 'down'.

port.description: Port inside its container. Required unless deployment is not-deployed.

healthPath.description: Default /health. Real exceptions: cms-service is /api/v1/health, the Spring services are /actuator/health.

container.description: Compose service name — answers 'what do I restart', which a port alone cannot.

publicHealthUrl.description: Set ONLY where the edge genuinely exposes this service's health endpoint on a whole-host route. Enables the edge-side probe that catches 'up internally, 502 at Caddy'. Omitted for path-carve-out routes, which expose no health path.
